data.body: Merged: change 3441 at 85ff756cf17e4b5cc624bb54f543d544e8a4872f (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). On merged main: `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_argparse.py -k version` 3 passed; `python scripts/probe_rebar.py` 144 passed, 0 failed; mechanism gate exit 0; wheel built from merged main (`uv build --wheel`) into a fresh venv: `rebar --version` -> `rebar 0.16.0 (6f5f854be4c)`, exit 0, importlib.metadata 0.16.0. The commit in that local wheel is the checkout's previously generated `_build_info.py` (the build preserves an existing one); release builds set REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT, and wheel_test compares against `_build_info.COMMIT`, so this does not affect releases. Windows sweep not dispatched: the change adds stdout text only, no subprocess, fd, path, encoding or permission code.
